notes.title: From Mages to Echoes: An Epic Journey
notes.content:
[h1] From Mages to Echoes: An Epic Journey
[/h1]
If creating a game is an adventure, meeting the players is the true reward. Your enthusiasm for our last title has been contagious. It inspired us to push further, to come back with something new. And today, that’s exactly what we’re doing—bringing you a brand-new chapter in the world of Mystralia.

[h2]The End of One Story. The Beginning of Another.
[/h2]
With Mages of Mystralia, our goal was to bring a little magic into the world. We wanted players to experience the thrill of spellcrafting firsthand. And your presence here proves this idea resonated. But launching our first game didn’t just satisfy our curiosity—it fueled it. We felt there was more to uncover in this magic system. New possibilities waiting to be explored. All we had to do was push a little further.

[h2]The Drive to Go Further
[/h2]
Mages of Mystralia offered a linear experience: story, combat, puzzles—the adventure was more or less the same for everyone. But magic, at its core, is about creation. Experimentation. In short, anything but linear. To take our system further, we had to embrace unpredictability and discovery. That’s the foundation of our new approach. A drive to give you more. More freedom. More flexibility. More magic. 

[h3]New System. New Genre.
[/h3]
But what does more really mean? More spells, obviously. But above all, more combinations. Every change to the spell had to reshape it. You know how it goes: one drop too many of frog’s saliva, and boom—everything blows up. That’s what we wanted. To see a small tweak create a big change. To get players excited about the possibilities. To spark their creativity. And for that to work, we needed a genre that would truly showcase our new system. We needed to build a rogue-lite, to let players craft new spells each run.

[h3]Another Meeting with You
[/h3]
So here’s the story. Mages was our bridge to you—a way to connect our passion with yours. And now, we’re about to cross that bridge once again. Soon, we’ll introduce you to a brand-new game. A new story. New factions. New lands to explore. But all within the same universe, with the same excitement, driven by the same wish we had from the very beginning: to bring a little magic into this world.

[b]🚨 Our first Steam Playtest for Echoes of Mystralia is live NOW! [/b]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/974480/Echoes_of_Mystralia/]Echoes of Mystralia Steam Playtest [/url]

We can't wait to see you again. 😄

The Borealys team

notes.title: Journey back to Mystralia: Join our first Playtest for Echoes of Mystralia!
notes.content:
Greetings friends and fellow Mystralians 🧙

It's been many springs since we've shared any news with you... the suspense has reached its peak!

[h1]What's up at Borealys Games?[/h1]
First, the Borealys Team wishes you a Happy New Year 2025!✨

Recently, the studio moved into new offices in Montreal. A place where we are happy to meet, share and grow together. The Borealys team is hard at work developing a new opus: Echoes Of Mystralia, which we announced last summer. Today, we are excited to share some fresh updates with you!😊

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jgpEMeEddMA

[h2]Join the first Steam Playtest of Echoes of Mystralia: Try our Convention Build from February 14th to 27th, 2025. [/h2]

Welcome to the Convention Build of Echoes of Mystralia, the sequel to Mages of Mystralia! You will step into the shoes of Mazarim, a Watcher of the Cycle of Memories, as you embark on a thrilling adventure in a vibrant, roguelite action-RPG experience. You will try our pre-alpha demo where you will find a new version of the spellcrafting system you discovered in Mages of Mystralia. You will be immersed in a fast-paced action roguelite, with a touch of RPG. You will learn to channel your inner magic to embark on a spellbinding journey to save Mystralia's memory!

We also want to extend a heartfelt thank you to everyone who shared a recommendation for Mages of Mystralia, you are all amazing! As our most valued ambassadors, we are happy to offer you the opportunity to test Echoes of Mystralia! 💜🎮

[h2]What is the Convention Build?[/h2]
The Convention Build is our first playable demo. We're giving you the chance to try it out from the comfort of your own home, from [b]February 14th to 27th, 2025[/b].

[h3]How it works?[/h3]
First, you’ll need a Steam account. If you don’t have one, visit the Steam website and click “Join Steam” to sign up. It’s free!
To participate you just have to register on the Steam Page here: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/974480/Echoes_of_Mystralia/]Echoes of Mystralia Playtest[/url]

[h3]How to register?[/h3]
To register for the playtest of Echoes of Mystralia on Steam, follow these steps:[b]

1. Log In to Steam: [/b]Open the Steam client and log in with your new account credentials.[b]

2. Join the Playtest:[/b] Look for announcements regarding the Echoes of Mystralia playtest. This may be through social media, the game’s official website, Steam’s community announcements but above all on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/Ge4sysstj3]Discord Server[/url].[b]

3. Opt-In to Playtest: [/b]Follow the instructions provided in the announcement to opt-in for the playtest. This usually involves clicking a link that leads to the game’s Steam page, where you can request access.[b]

4. Check Your Library:[/b] Once you have registered, keep an eye on your Steam Library. When you will be selected for the playtest, the game will appear in your library, and you’ll be able to download and play it during the specified dates.[b]

5. Provide Feedback:[/b] We craft games FOR players, and we strongly believe that working hand in hand with our community can only bring out the best. That's why we look forward to your feedback on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/Ge4sysstj3]Discord Server[/url]. Enjoy your adventure in Echoes of Mystralia!

[b]Our playtest is open to everyone, and we hope to see many of you there![/b]


See you soon!

Warmest regards from Borealys Games 💖

notes.title: Mages of Mystralia v1.6.26515
notes.content:
You have been a lot of people playing the game since the launch last year and we are very grateful for that. Today we are deploying a big patch containing the following changes, which we hope will improve even more your playing experience.

[h1]Additions / Changes[/h1]
- Added the Hardcore Mode, same as the Archmage Mode with permanent death.
- Added localization for the Japanese, Hungarian, Polish and Korean languages.
- Changed the video playback system to avoid jittering in some cases.
- Improved tutorials comprehension in the spell book.
- Revised the Chinese localization.

[h1]Optimizations[/h1]
- Optimized every levels in the game to better support low hardwares.
- Optimized every spell particle systems to reduce lags.

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
- Fixed a crash preventing the game from launching with conflicting resolutions.
- Fixed various crashes when loading a new level.
- Fixed typos in many languages.

[h1]Misc[/h1]
- Upgraded to Unity 5.6.6

notes.title: Archmage Mode Update v1.4
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27032682/4b4e1c1b522f61d018b08d0b36be89254576b138.jpg[/img]

PS: Detailed patch notes available below, please restart your client to get the update!

Greetings Mystralians,

We are excited to officially announce that the Archmage Mode patch is now deployed on Steam. Since the game launched last May, we've been working hard on this big patch for Mages of Mystralia.

With the Archmage Mode patch, Mages of Mystralia now offers a much more challenging gameplay experience, if you so choose, that will put your skills to the test, adds keybind remapping for keyboard and mouse and adds more bug fixes than you can count.

So what is the Archmage Mode exactly? It is an optional harder difficulty mode which contains harder battles, smarter new enemies and more complex puzzles. First, we’ve added 4 new enemy types - one for each element - that are only found in the Archmage Mode. These enemies not only deal more damage than typical enemies, they approach the player differently, they can add elemental effects to their attacks and they anticipate your actions better.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27032682/dec38358dc62487a008e7ba665e1c3f6c950680f.jpg[/img]

Also, most of the optional puzzles sprinkled throughout the game which test your spell crafting skills and require you to design interesting spells to achieve a specific goal have been ramped up in terms of complexity and will require players to use more advanced spell crafting techniques in the Archmage Mode. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27032682/94debe5975da80602a2c2e77fadc525a128eafaf.jpg[/img]

In addition to these new challenges, we have added some new side quests and locations for you to discover on your adventure.

We hope you will enjoy this new update and that it will give you a chance to dive into the world of Mystralia and achieve spell crafting mastery! 

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]

[h1]Archmage mode (harder difficulty)[/h1]
- Performed a major balancing pass on enemies and bosses (Stats buff, changed bosses patterns, etc.).
- Added an Elite Imp for each elemental type (Elite imps deal elemental damage based on their type: earth, fire, air and ice).
- Improved enemy behaviors [spoiler](eg. Treant’s roots now have a ranged attack (both modes), Wild Boar Imp throws three barrels instead of one (Archmage only), Ghost clones now throw projectiles (both modes), etc.)[/spoiler].
- Added different secret room puzzles that require more thinking.
- Adjusted enemy spawns (More and/or different enemies spawn in every fight in the game).
 
[h1]Added/Enhanced sidequests[/h1]
- Reworked the [spoiler]farmers, the fisherman and flowers[/spoiler] side quests.
- Added new puzzle room [spoiler]for the chest puzzle in Mystralia (Gaia's wand). The player may now enter a small dungeon and has to avoid being caught by the guards to get the wand[/spoiler].
- Improved side quests [spoiler](GhostBuster, Wares, etc.) to make it easier for players to understand what they need to do and where to turn in their quests.[/spoiler]
- Added an '!' over NPCs who are waving at you for a sidequest.
 
[h1]Wand Balancing[/h1]
[spoiler]
- Negation wand: Still ignores enemy resistance but now has an overall damage reduction.
- All elemental wands (Fire, Gaia, Aura, Aqua): Now ignore the resistance of their specific element.
 [/spoiler]

[h1]Keybind remapping[/h1]
- Added keybind remapping for keyboard and mouse.
- Changed casting Creo on keyboard and mouse to only require casting with the Shift key by default instead of the Shift-clicking. 

[h1]Misc[/h1]
- Upgraded to Unity version 5.5.4.
- Decreased game launch time.
- Tweaked balancing in Normal/Mage mode.
- Reduced the 'turn' animation length when doing a 180 degree turn.
- Improved keyboard movement.
- Changed quickspell to work on the first keypress when using mouse and keyboard.
- Lowered Health drop rate probability.
- Added a training room in Haven where players can test their spells on training dummies.
- [spoiler]Added a shortcut from the old port to the upper city in Mystralia so that players don't need to go through the sewer every time[/spoiler].
- Fixed game breaker when quitting game just after the ghost battle in the the crypt.
- Fixed corrupted saves issue when the player quits the game then activates a save afterwards.
- Added video playback being affected by the master volume slider.
- Fixed achievement failing to unlock once for whatever reason would prevent the player from unlocking the achievement forever.
- Fixed shield staying up forever when holding the shield, not letting go, and being hit by enemies.
- Added additional audio feedback during the [spoiler]Treant and Ghost Queen[/spoiler] boss fights.
- Added lanterns in the [spoiler]Mystral Wood, the Rise, the Sky Temple and the Greyleaf Village[/spoiler].
- Reduced hint cost.
- Clarified the game's ending.
- Fixed player being able to [spoiler]reflect light even when the source of light is “turned off”[/spoiler].
- Fixed player being able to walk on water during the [spoiler]Ghost fight in the the Highlands[/spoiler].
- Fixed seeing radial timer feedback on switches in the game over screen.
- Fixed many cameras.
- Fixed many collisions.
- Fixed many typos.
- And many more minor fixes and tweaks.

notes.title: Mages of Mystralia v1.3.27354
notes.content:
We’ve just deployed a big bug fix patch. 
 
Notably, we’ve upgraded our Unity engine which should fix most rare system specific crashes that some players have been having.
 
- Upgraded to Unity version 5.5.3.
- Fixed Creo spells not being able to unlock the "kill 5 goblins with one spell" achievement.
- Fix directional pad not working with the Steam’s default controller configurations.
- Improve player movement responsiveness.
- Added remaining Kickstarter statues.
- Fixed [spoiler]Purple Soulbeads[/spoiler] being lost forever sometimes.
- Increased duration of quickspell menu when playing with keyboard and mouse.
- Replaced mp4 video with a wmv video for improved compatibility.
- Fixed chandelier in the [spoiler]Greyleaf Hamlet[/spoiler] blocking the player forever.
- Fixed bug with player’s Ego shield staying up when the player gets hit while holding the shield sometimes.
- Fixed [spoiler]Negation Scepter[/spoiler]not working on [spoiler]Scaald[/spoiler].
- Fixed current location of the player on the map not being displayed if the player finished main storyline.
- Updated many collisions.
- Fixed typos.
- Removed “localization is a work-in-progress” popups.
- Fixed player getting stuck in the settings menu in a specific edge case.
 
NB: Please restart your Steam client to force the detection and download of this patch.

notes.title: What's next for Mages of Mystralia?
notes.content:
We launched Mages of Mystralia almost one week ago today. Everyone at the studio has been really happy to see so many players playing and enjoying the game. It is a surreal experience for us to see the game we've worked on for so long be played by players all over the world.

Now that the dust has settled, we feel comfortable talking about what's coming soon for Mages of Mystralia. 

Our top priorities for the near future will be:
[list]
[*] Fixing bugs and crashes.
[*] Optimizing the game for lower-end PCs.
[*] Implementing a keybind remapping menu for mouse and keyboard.
[*] Adding the rest of the Kickstarter backer content.
[/list]
Also, we will be working on some additional game modes to allow players to customize their experience and encourage multiple playthroughs.

The game modes that we'll be adding are the following:
[list]
[*] Archmage difficulty mode: a harder difficulty mode for experienced mages.
[*] Hardcore mode: a permadeath mode.
[*] Speedrun mode: "Gotta Go Fast" mode.
[/list]
That's all that we will be revealing for now, but you can expect more to come soon™.
 
Thank you for your support!

notes.title: Mages of Mystralia v1.0.27147
notes.content:
We’ve deployed one more patch before the release of the game tomorrow. Everyone at the studio is really excited for the release and we hope you are as well.

We’ve added some more Kickstarter content to the game. We’ll be pushing out the rest of the post-launch Kickstarter content including the Archmage mode and Hardcore mode in the near future, so stay tuned for that. Thankfully, these modes will be available to non-Kickstarter players as well.

Thank you all for your continued support and we hope you have as much fun playing game as we had making it. This isn’t the end for Mages of Mystralia, it’s just the beginning.

- Added some post-launch Kickstarter content (more to come soon).
[list]
[*] Built the Altar of Ages in Haven.
[*] Posted the Wanted Mages billboards all across Mystralia.
[*] Built Gravestones and Tombs.
[*] Sculpted the Statue of Debrusid
[*] Wrote and placed a book in the Crypt of the Mage-Kings.
[*] Renamed certain NPCs.
[/list]
- Fixed missing characters in Russian and Chinese fonts
- Fixed At Once trigger with a nested melee spell spawning the nested melee spell next to the player instead of where at the location of the parent spell.

notes.title: Mages of Mystralia Beta v0.3.26834
notes.content:
Prepare yourselves for the biggest Mages of Mystralia patch yet! We hope you enjoy the new content and have fun breaking it.

Please continue submitting bugs through the Beta Bug Reports sub forum and sending any crashes reports to qa@borealysgames.com, with your help, we’ll be able to make Mages of Mystralia a great experience for mages all across the world.

[h1]Additions[/h1]
- Added four new runes and two new wands (for those who collected any broken runes and/or broken wands they should now be repaired).
- Added the Trial of the Mage, an endgame challenge for experienced mages.
- Added an intro video with an intro cinematic.

[h1]Changes[/h1]
- Improved Homing rune behavior.
- Improved [spoiler]Aqua Ego’s ability to reflect light (more lenient on the angle)[/spoiler].
- Improved keyboard and mouse controls:
[list]
     [*] Improved targeting.
     [*] Improved use of shield (Self) and dash (Self-Move) allowing the player to control Zia’s orientation with the mouse.
[/list]
- Improved feedback when a Creo despawns when being spawned over an incompatible ground (lava or water)

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
- Fixed problems with the intro video crashing (black screen at start).
- Fixed Tomb of the Mage Kings loading forever.
- Fixed player being able to delete all of his spells of one type.
- Fixed player’s deleted spells not actually being deleted sometimes.
- Fixed multiple bugs when the player opened a menu while falling or drowning.
- Fixed killing Scald when he’s frozen preventing him from dying
- Fixed when exactly two controllers connected then one of them is not usable.
- Fixed Creo spells not despawning.
- Fixed nested spells not targeting anything except usable items.
- Fixed multiple progression errors in several levels including the [spoiler]Mine, the Tomb of the Mage Kings, the Highlands[/spoiler].
- Fixed [spoiler]Ghost Buster ghosts’s[/spoiler] projectiles dealing damage to player when using a shield.
- Fixed popup reward text spilling out sometimes.
- Fixed being able to activate a teleport stone twice when using [spoiler]the Broken Portal Stone[/spoiler].
- Fix bug with save/load icon showing up in menus.
- Fixed Mastery damage not being applied correctly with [spoiler]Negation Scepter[/spoiler].
- Fixed multiple typos.

notes.title: Mages of Mystralia Beta v0.1.26705
notes.content:
Hi! We’ve made a small hotfix patch for the beta with some fixes and tweaks to help you enjoy the game even more.

Please continue submitting bugs through the Beta Bug Reports sub forum, with your help, we’ll be able to make Mages of Mystralia a better game for everybody. We appreciate your support!

- Fixed not being able to plant a Magic Lily Bulb or buy a Mana Charm from the Enchanter's garden (you’ll need to start a new game for this fix to work).
- Fixed a path to Greyleaf being blocked.
- Added a failsafe to skip the intro video if unable to load the video.
- Fixed being able to buy multiple Magic Lily Bulbs from Chaz at Greyleaf.
- Fixed multiple dialogue boxes going off screen.
- Fixed the game not correctly remembering the player switching the keyboard from QWERTY to AZERTY after relaunching the game.
- Fixed "The Mage's Path" (collect all runes) and "The Mage's Arsenal" (collect all wands) achievements unlocking too early.
- Corrected multiple rune and wand descriptions.
- Corrected multiple typos.
- Fixed multiple collision bugs.
- Fixed multiple performance issues.
- Reduced the cost of teleportation to 10 Green Soulstones and the cost of the Portal Stone to 75 Green Soulstones.
- Tweaked the look of shortcut visuals when using keyboard and mouse so that they no longer look like buttons.
- Simplified the [spoiler]bird puzzle[/spoiler].
- Replaced the  [spoiler]'2 Lardees' by a stronger one during the sidequest 'A Lardee's Revenge'[/spoiler] to avoid confusion.
